title: A worker or reviewer in a worktree reads its own worktree's kb, not the main checkout's, through the kb MCP server
goal: kb_mcp.py answers from the checkout the session runs in (its working directory's clone), or the worker and reviewer briefs tell a worktree session to use rag.py there, so a session in a worktree does not read a main checkout that is behind origin/main; seen in the SP-wwacrsqr review, where the kb server, registered at local scope with the main checkout's absolute _tools/kb_mcp.py path, served a checkout 33 commits behind and missed the sprint's new articles until the reviewer fell back to rag.py (SP-wwacrsqr retrospective).
